items.title: Locally closed subspaces of an algebraic space presented by an etale equivalence relation

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for the algebraic space X presented by an etale equivalence relation R on a scheme U there is a canonical bijection between the R-invariant locally closed subschemes of U and the locally closed subspaces of X, matching closedness and openness (statement lines 1631-1644). The proof (proof lines 1646-1681) sends a subspace to its base change along the presentation, constructs the inverse by restricting the relation to an invariant subscheme and applying the presentation theorem, and uses fppf descent of immersions to conclude. H2: two constructions with a descent step, written out in full.
